source_evidence: Exact V reply 'All of the above, depending on the offer' expresses interest in paid passage, trade and military service conditional on actual terms; no acceptance, permission, employment, spending or disclosure of destination. H1 offers newly adjudicated preliminary negotiating figures within his ordinary company knowledge, subject to captain ratification: 5gp per full-company passage using a specifically agreed route over land V can lawfully control, not a toll on a public road, no automatic camp/garrison or exclusive rights; company purchases its own food, fodder, repairs and storage at agreed local rates as available, no guaranteed minimum orders or advance; a four-soldier professional escort/security detachment at indicative12gp per day including its own provisions and ordinary company overhead, actual availability and assignment subject to captain and agreed scope, not three Iron Shadows automatically available at that rate. H1 states the company numbers about three dozen fighting members (spoken claim, not independently verified; no reinforcements at encounter) and that he cannot bind the company; more substantial work to be quoted separately. He proposes carrying terms to his captain and asks where to deliver a reply or arrange a meeting. No actual price acceptance, paid passage, verified title, supply purchase, hiring, military alliance, company movement, meeting or additional NPC presence. Existing independent reconnaissance motive, cautious stance and tactical positions unchanged. Ordinary volunteered offer, no uncertain concession/check or RNG, no V resource expenditure or additional speech.
